% fig_iterates: sigma-iterate convergence of the selection procedure.
% Data: fig_iterates/iterates.csv + fig_margin_curve/scales.csv
% (regenerated by scripts/p019_sigma_procedure.py figures).
% Two stacked aligned axes (never dual-axis): top sigma_k/R per iteration
% with the initializer scales; bottom M_k (log) vs the target eps.
% Compile: pdflatex (from this dir).
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usepgfplotslibrary{groupplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.17}
\definecolor{cit}{HTML}{0072B2}
\definecolor{cref}{HTML}{707070}
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{fig_iterates/iterates.csv}\iters
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{fig_margin_curve/scales.csv}\scales
\pgfplotstablegetelem{0}{value}\of\scales \let\vEPS\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{1}{value}\of\scales \let\vSEQ\pgfplotsretval
\pgfplotstablegetelem{2}{value}\of\scales \let\vSSTAB\pgfplotsretval
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{groupplot}[
  group style={group size=1 by 2, vertical sep=14pt,
    xlabels at=edge bottom, xticklabels at=edge bottom},
  width=9.0cm, height=4.6cm,
  xmin=-0.5, xmax=5.5, xtick={0,1,2,3,4,5},
  xlabel={iteration $k$},
  grid=major, grid style={cref!25, very thin},
  axis line style={cref!70},
  tick label style={font=\small}, label style={font=\small},
]
% --- top: sigma_k/R ---
\nextgroupplot[ylabel={$\sigma_k/R$}, ymin=0, ymax=0.05]
\addplot[cref, dashed, thin, domain=-0.5:5.5] {\vSSTAB}
  node[pos=0.98, below left, font=\scriptsize, text=cref] {$\sigma_{stab}$};
\addplot[cref, dashed, thin, domain=-0.5:5.5] {2*\vSEQ}
  node[pos=0.98, above left, font=\scriptsize, text=cref] {$2\sigma_{eq}$};
\addplot[cit, semithick, mark=*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cit, fill=cit}]
  table[col sep=comma, x=k, y=sigma_over_R]{fig_iterates/iterates.csv};
% --- bottom: M_k vs eps ---
\nextgroupplot[ylabel={$M_k$}, ymode=log, ymin=1e-3, ymax=10]
\addplot[black, densely dotted, thick, domain=-0.5:5.5] {\vEPS}
  node[pos=0.98, above left, font=\scriptsize]
  {$\varepsilon=\vEPS$};
\addplot[cit, semithick, mark=*, mark size=2.4pt,
  mark options={draw=cit, fill=cit}]
  table[col sep=comma, x=k, y=M]{fig_iterates/iterates.csv};
\end{groupplot}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
